newsitem.title: UK: UK's Chelsfield may buy Imry Holdings-paper.
newsitem.headline: UK's Chelsfield may buy Imry Holdings-paper.

text.p: UK property company Chelsfield Plc may be aabout to buy property investment group Imry Holdings, a subsidiary of Barclays Bank, the Sunday Times said.
Meanwhile British Land is believed to be standing by the Chelsfield bid collapse, it added.
"Chelsfield...is thought to be close to buying Imry Holdings, the property investment company owned by Barclays bank," the paper said.
"Although (Chelsfield owner Elliot) Bernerd is believed to be in advanced talks with Barclays, British Land is thought to be waiting in the wings should the deal fall through."
The paper said Imry has some 400 million stg in assets, and if Bernerd's bid succeeds it would mark a considerable advance for Chelsfield whose current market value is 557 million stg.
"It is understood that Barclays has long regarded Imry as an investment to be sold at some stage," the paper added. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
